say:1:1035616001:1.text: Not all treasure thieves are bad. I may have been that way before, but now I heed the call of my goddess...
say:1:1035616001:1.source_cn: 不是所有盗宝贼都那么庸俗。也许我曾经如此，但我已聆听到...
say:1:1035616001:1.male: Not all treasure thieves are bad. I may have been that way before, but now I heed the call of my goddess...
say:1:1035616001:1.female: Not all treasure thieves are bad. I may have been that way before, but now I heed the call of my goddess...

say:2:1035616002:1.text: In that mysterious place, a glimmer of divine power shines once more...
say:2:1035616002:1.source_cn: 在那神秘之处，神力重现的微光之中……
say:2:1035616002:1.male: In that mysterious place, a glimmer of divine power shines once more...
say:2:1035616002:1.female: In that mysterious place, a glimmer of divine power shines once more...
